raw_text: The Indian Navy is closely monitoring a Chinese research vessel that entered India's exclusive economic zone near the Andaman and Nicobar Islands without prior intimation, defence sources said on Tuesday. The vessel, identified as Yuan Wang 5, is officially described as a space tracking ship but is widely believed to conduct signals intelligence gathering. A P-8I maritime patrol aircraft and a frontline frigate have been deployed to shadow the vessel, which has been intermittently switching off its automatic identification system transponder.
clean_text: Indian Navy monitoring Chinese vessel Yuan Wang 5 that entered EEZ near Andaman and Nicobar Islands without prior intimation. P-8I aircraft and frigate deployed to shadow vessel which intermittently disabled AIS.
